commands.name: search-fide-players
commands.summary: Search or list FIDE-rated players, sortable by name or classical/rapid/blitz rating, paginated 30 per page

commands.name: list-fide-player-broadcasts
commands.summary: List recent broadcast tournaments a FIDE player took part in, newest first, paginated

commands.name: list-fide-federations
commands.summary: List FIDE federations with player counts and average top ratings, paginated 30 per page

commands.name: get-fide-federation-stats
commands.summary: Get a FIDE federation's world rank, top-10 average rating and player count for classical, rapid and blitz (one item per category)

commands.name: list-fide-federation-players
commands.summary: List the FIDE players of one federation, sortable by name or rating, paginated 30 per page

commands.name: search-broadcasts
commands.summary: Search official live tournament broadcasts by keyword, or list live/upcoming ones when q is omitted, 24 per page

commands.name: list-broadcast-calendar
commands.summary: List all broadcast tournaments scheduled in the current month's broadcast calendar

commands.name: list-leaderboards
commands.summary: List lichess's top-10 leaderboard for every rating category (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, variants)

commands.name: list-online-players
commands.summary: List the strongest lichess players who are online right now, with their rating (username is the last path segment of url)

commands.name: list-tournament-winners
commands.summary: List recent winners of lichess's recurring arena tournaments (Elite, HyperBullet, Yearly, Monthly, Marathon...) by category

commands.name: get-tournament
commands.summary: Get a lichess arena tournament's name, format/time control, start time, description and winner profile url
